title: Sheet Pan Lemon Chicken
reject_reason: Lemon-rosemary-garlic chicken with baby potatoes and asparagus sheet pan is the same chicken+potato bake as live parmesan-garlic-sheet-pan-chicken-potatoes, a seasoning-only difference matching the prior easy-chicken-and-potatoes ruling.
